disclaimer: Distributions are controlled generator coverage, not real-world email prevalence.

observability_label_association.note: A gap of 25 percentage points on inferred rich or low coverage is treated as observability acting like a class proxy. Smaller gaps can still follow frozen profile weights.

shortcut_audit.note: Moderate profile-weight differences are expected construction choices, not automatically label shortcuts. Rare exclusive tokens at full-corpus n are listed even when they fall below the 8% exclusive-value cutoff.

text_artifact_audit.note: Mailing-list/citation brackets and rare HTML-deleted notes were intentionally kept in real seed text. They are not removed here.

url_count_audit.note: Agent url_count may be about 2× logical URLs for multipart/alternative. 4×/12× peaks are generator duplication, not realistic MIME alternatives.

template_profile_audit.note: header_template_id is a cartesian product of shared component templates. Single-occurrence composites are expected sparsity, not label encoding. A composite is flagged only if it appears at least 8 times and is confined to one profile and one label.
